positions.name: SlugGenerationOnMissingId
positions.frame: when no explicit id is submitted, how must the pipeline resolve slug generation and file commit?
positions.why: src-1 flatly states the submission arrived without an explicit id field; src-2 then lays down the deontic requirement ("must produce a slug... via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback... and commit the file successfully") that follows from that absence. Read together, one states the triggering condition and the other the binding pipeline obligation it triggers — a single directional read spanning both expressions, not two independent claims. No tension to resolve: the two are sequential premise and consequence.
